title: Close Knit · What people look at
description: Time spent, the analytics and places people open, map use and searches (docs/product-analytics.md).

list.name: traffic
list.label: Traffic
list.description: Live = people and their assistants; Team = our own checks and visits; Tech = scanners and scripts.
list.query: Live : live, Team : team, Tech : tech

panels.title: Engaged hours, 7 days
panels.description: Hours with the tab visible and the reader active in the last 30 s, all people.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) / 3600 FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'engagement' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Minutes a person spends a day
panels.description: Median engaged minutes per person on the days they came, last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) / 60 FROM ( SELECT visitor_id, occurred_at::date, sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) AS seconds FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'engagement' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2) d

panels.title: Visit length
panels.description: Median time from a visit's first to last event (wall-clock, idle included), last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM last - first)) FROM ( SELECT session_id, min(occurred_at) AS first, max(occurred_at) AS last FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1) v

panels.title: Map views, 7 days
panels.description: Pans and zooms people made (at most one counted every 2 s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'map_view' AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, 1d), sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) / 3600 AS "hours" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'engagement' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time by page (minutes)
panels.description: Where the time goes: / is the map; homes and postcodes are templates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'path' AS page, round(sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) / 60) AS minutes FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'engagement' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Time by map layer (minutes)
panels.description: Engaged time on the map, split by the layer on screen. custom:<slug> is a ready-made criterion, custom:own one people built.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'layer' AS layer, round(sum((props->>'seconds')::numeric) / 60) AS minutes FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'layer_time' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top analytics (map layers)
panels.description: Built-in metrics, My match (personal-match) and custom criteria. 'Opened with the page' is the layer a link or the default showed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN props->>'layer' = 'custom' THEN 'custom: ' || coalesce(props->>'preset', 'own · ' || coalesce(props->>'label', '?')) ELSE props->>'layer' END AS analytic, count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) FILTER (WHERE NOT coalesce((props->>'initial')::boolean, false)) AS "people who chose it", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT coalesce((props->>'initial')::boolean, false)) AS "times chosen", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (props->>'initial')::boolean) AS "opened with the page" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'layer_view' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 4 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Custom criteria: ready-made and people's own
panels.description: preset = one of the ready-made criteria (by slug); own = built by the reader from neutral place types (its label).

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'custom' AS kind, coalesce(props->>'preset', props->>'label', '?') AS criterion, count(DISTINCT coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id)) AS people, count(*) AS times FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'layer_view' AND props->>'layer' = 'custom' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY people DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Sub-views inside a topic
panels.description: Views and scales picked within a map topic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'layer' AS topic, props->>'view' AS view, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people, count(*) AS times FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'layer_subview' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Area page cards opened
panels.description: Cards on the full area page (price, sales, living, schools, around, environment, planning, council, home); 'all' is Open all.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'section' AS card, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'section_open' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC

panels.title: Where people look on the map
panels.description: Centres of the map after people's own pans and zooms, to about a kilometre.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (props->>'lat')::float AS lat, (props->>'lng')::float AS lng, count(*) AS views FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'map_view' AND props ? 'lat' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2

panels.title: Top areas
panels.description: Areas selected on the map, the ranking or search, opened from a shortlist, or read on their page.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS ( SELECT props->>'area' AS area, coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id) AS who FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name IN ('area_select', 'area_open', 'section_open') AND props ? 'area' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) UNION ALL SELECT 'uk:lsoa:' || substring(props->>'path' FROM '^/area/lsoa/([A-Z0-9]+)'), coalesce(visitor_id::text, session_id) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/area/lsoa/' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)) SELECT coalesce(l.friendly_name || coalesce(' · ' || l.postcode_district, ''), v.area) AS area, v.area AS id, count(DISTINCT who) AS people, count(*) AS looks FROM v LEFT JOIN area_label l ON l.geography_id = v.area GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY people DESC, looks DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT 'zoom ' || lpad(floor((props->>'zoom')::float)::int::text, 2, '0') AS zoom, count(*) AS views FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'map_view' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: How areas get selected
panels.description: map = a click on the map; ranking = My match list; search; match_map = shortlist pins; panel = a neighbouring area link.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'from' AS "from", count(*) AS times FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'area_select' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY times DESC

panels.title: Zones people set in Find my area
panels.description: Stations, boroughs and neighbourhoods by name; a drawn shape by its rough centre.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'kind' AS kind, coalesce(props->>'place', CASE WHEN props ? 'lat' THEN 'drawn near ' || (props->>'lat') || ', ' || (props->>'lng') END) AS place, count(*) FILTER (WHERE props->>'action' = 'add') AS added, count(*) FILTER (WHERE props->>'action' = 'remove') AS removed, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'zone_change' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY added DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: What people type
panels.description: Typed text that led to a chosen result: words as typed, a postcode as its district, anything with a house number as [with digits].

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'query' AS query, count(*) AS times, count(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS people, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY props->>'kind') AS "usually chose" FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'search' AND props ? 'query' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: What they chose
panels.description: An area by name; a home, street or postcode only by its district.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'kind' AS kind, coalesce(props->>'label', coalesce(l.friendly_name || coalesce(' · ' || l.postcode_district, ''), props->>'area'), props->>'district') AS place, count(*) AS times FROM product_event LEFT JOIN area_label l ON l.geography_id = props->>'area' WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'search' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT props->>'query' AS query, count(*) AS times FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'search_empty' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 25
